judgeIssues.detail: Run-level term collision for 'margin': this slice consistently renders it 'marjin' (i=1480, 1481, 1483, 1485, 1486, 1491, 1494, 1502, 1562, 1568), while the rest of the run renders the same term 'marj' (e.g. i=1677 'Maliyet bazlı marj', 1703, 1743, 1754, 1766, 1770, 1771, 1787–1794).
